name: io.github.laaielichter/agathos
title: AgathOS
description: Local watcher for AI agents: audits MCP servers, finds hidden prompt injection, checks risky steps.

environmentVariables.name: AGATHOS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Agent access key from the AgathOS app (Settings > Agent access). Without it only the built-in checks run.

environmentVariables.name: AGATHOS_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: File that holds the agent access key, instead of AGATHOS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.name: AGATHOS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port of the local AgathOS app API (default 47612)
